rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound guḍa+varjita qualifying tilāḥ; analyzed as given
bahuvrīhi compound kemuka+varjita qualifying kandaḥ; kemuka denotes a specific plant

items.question: Which specific food items qualify as wholesome for the practitioner?
premises: The practitioner should consume praised food to avoid loss of success.
Sesame seeds devoid of jaggery are included among suitable foods.
White mung beans are included among suitable foods.
Bulb devoid of kemuka is included among suitable foods.
items.inference: These specified items constitute part of the wholesome diet prescribed for the practitioner.
uncertainties: The exact botanical identity of kemuka is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: Sesame without jaggery, and indeed white mung beans, and bulb excluding kemuka are prescribed.
